Hi Olivia — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and the questionnaire. Confirming: Wed 7/22 9–10am PT is on our side as well; Lauren will send the calendar invite.

Answers to your asks (high-level):
- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report for period Jan–Dec 2025. The scope covers our hosted API endpoints, authentication, and the embeddings service (production inference path). We’ll attach a one-page summary (attached). Full report available under NDA — happy to coordinate that with your legal team.
- Data residency: Hosted regions currently include us-west and eu-west; we can route requests to eu-west for GDPR-sensitive workloads. For Private deployments we support customer-managed VPCs and on-prem options which FinCo can use if strict residency is required.
- HIPAA: We do not currently market a HIPAA-compliant offering out of the box, but we support BAAs for enterprise Private deployments; this is something we can scope with your security and legal teams.

I’m attaching the vendor security questionnaire template (redwood-vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx) prefilled with the SOC/DPO answers we discussed. If you prefer, we can also import your FinCo sheet directly into our tracker and highlight gaps.

Related links:
- SOC 2 summary: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-redwood-soc2
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/FINCO-6789

Let me know if you want anything else ahead of the deep-dive.

Best —
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: FinCo - Security & Compliance follow-up (SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA)

Hi all — chipping in with the info Olivia asked about and some specifics we can cover on Wed: 

- SOC 2 Type II report: period Jan–Dec 2025. Controls: CC1-CC8 mapped; scope: API endpoints, inference runtime, telemetry/logging, key management integration (KMS). We can provide the report under NDA; summary attached.
- ISO 27001: Roadmap currently targeted for Q4 2026 for certification initiation (gap assessment scheduled Aug 2026). This will expand our formal ISMS and help customers with additional compliance requirements.
- SOC scope expansion: We plan to include Dedicated and Private control plane components in the next SOC cycle (target 2027 reporting period).
- FedRAMP: exploratory — we have an internal task force mapping controls to FedRAMP High baselines; timelines TBD and likely multi-year.
- HIPAA / BAA: We support BAAs for Private deployments; for hosted we can discuss contractual safeguards and additional logging/encryption options.

For the deep-dive agenda I suggest: 1) Data flow & residency options, 2) SOC controls coverage, 3) HIPAA considerations and BAA path, 4) Roadmap (ISO/SOC scope/FedRAMP), 5) Open questions from your questionnaire.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
